title: コモンズ・ティールの織布
description: 細密な織り目の深い青緑色の布。椅子やソファの張り地に。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
descriptionEn: Deep teal woven upholstery for chairs and sofas. Base color only. Set both axes to Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrapping. Opposite edges are not guaranteed to match under ordinary Repeat.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Mirror / mirrored-repeat sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: Deep desaturated petrol teal upholstery fabric, extremely fine tightly woven basket weave visible across uniform textile surface, soft small interlaced fibers, low contrast. NO folds, no seams, no buttons.

usage: Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
